description: Compare Profhilo and Profhilo Structura in Cairo. Learn why skin quality and facial support are assessed separately and what to ask before an injection.
h1: Profhilo and Profhilo Structura in Cairo
answer: Profhilo and Profhilo Structura are injectable hyaluronic acid options with different intended uses. Adults concerned about changes in skin quality or facial tissue may discuss them at {{brand}} in New Cairo and Mohandessin. A consultation distinguishes hydration concerns from loss of support and checks whether either product fits the goal.
preparation: Bring the names of any previous injectables. An infection in the area or an unexplained reaction to a previous product needs assessment first.
howPerformed: After examining the skin and facial tissues, the team explains which product it proposes, the areas to treat and the follow-up plan.
followup: Small bumps, bruising or puffiness can appear after injections. Follow the agreed skin care and return for review once swelling has settled.
risks: Injections carry risks of infection and impaired blood supply. Seek urgent care for severe pain, unusual colour change or visual symptoms.
